errors.error_description: Assigned a constant to an input port using a continuous assign, illegally driving an input and assigning to a variable type.
Instantiated a not gate with a 1-bit output driven by a 32-bit input vector, creating a port width mismatch at the instance boundary.
Used an always_comb block that does not assign overflow_c on all paths, causing unintended latch inference.
Declared and used an escaped identifier named after the reserved keyword 'always_comb', misusing a reserved word as an identifier.
